title: ARDS, deep sedation: reverse triggering
summary: Machine breaths entrain the respiratory centre 1:1 with a 0.4 s delay. Each mandatory breath is followed by an effort visible as a mid-inspiratory Paw dip in VC, and sometimes a stacked breath.
objectives: Distinguish reverse triggering (effort after the machine breath, fixed delay) from a patient-triggered breath.
Use the truth layer to see the entrained Pmus and Pes swing.
